easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Thassa's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Thassa's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.
